name: Story Animation Polish
description: Per-image reveal animations (fade-in, gentle zoom) for story chapter photos, replacing current static placeholder slots with scroll-triggered Framer Motion effects. Deferred from feat-005 for mobile performance
acceptanceCriteria: Story images animate into view with fade-in and gentle zoom on scroll (whileInView)
Animations are subtle and match wedding aesthetic (no flashy effects)
prefers-reduced-motion fully respected: animations disabled when user prefers reduced motion
Animation density stays performant on mobile (no per-card stagger that causes jank)
StoryImageSlot component no longer has unnecessary 'use client' directive if no client-side logic needed
Animations work with real images (next/image) and placeholder slots alike
pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build pass
evidence: StoryImageSlot now animates real `next/image` chapter photos with reduced-motion-safe fade-in + gentle zoom, no stagger between cards, fixed 4:3 cards, and responsive hero-span placement for awkward image counts. Animation: initial opacity:0 scale:1.03 → whileInView opacity:1 scale:1, duration 0.5s easeOut, viewport once:true amount:0.2. Reduced-motion users see no animation (initial:false, whileInView:undefined). Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, and ./init.sh on 2026-05-21.
notes: Originally part of feat-002 scope but deferred during feat-005 performance pass to avoid per-card animation overload on mobile. Decision remains: no stagger at all — all images in a chapter animate simultaneously for mobile performance. Only `StoryImageSlot` remains client-side for Framer Motion hooks; the story shell itself is server-rendered again.
